title: Dual-oxide diffusion barrier boosts efficiency of mass-produced TOPCon solar cells by 0.07 percentage points
summary: Chinese researchers have developed a dual silicon oxide diffusion barrier strategy that improves phosphorus distribution and reduces contact resistance and optical losses in TOPCon solar cells. The industry-compatible process increased average cell efficiency from 27.15% to 27.22%, an absolute gain of 0.07 percentage points. The post Dual-oxide diffusion barrier boosts efficiency of mass-produced TOPCon solar cells by 0.07 percentage points appeared first on pv magazine Global .
